skill.name: ai-content-pipeline
skill.description: Build repeatable AI content workflows that combine text, image, video, audio, upscaling, captions, and media merging through inference.sh CLI examples.
skill.summary: Create multi-step media workflows with inference.sh apps for scripts, visuals, voiceovers, animation, and final assembly.
skill.author: inference-sh

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences or inline app names. The real issue is the Quick Start command that downloads a remote installer and pipes it directly to sh without integrity verification.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell installation with package-manager instructions or a download, checksum verification, and explicit execution flow.

remediation.issue: Workflow examples send prompts and media URLs to hosted inference services.
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note telling users to avoid private or regulated content unless their organization approves the external services.

content.value_statement: Multi-step media production often requires many tools and repeated handoffs. This skill maps text, image, video, and audio steps into repeatable inference.sh workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides image-to-video-to-audio workflows using inference.sh CLI apps.
Provides workflows for YouTube Shorts, talking head videos, product demos, and blog-to-video production.
Lists app choices for scripts, research, images, animation, audio, upscaling, merging, and captions.
Shows command examples with inputs, output files, media URLs, and intermediate assets.
Recommends planning, saved intermediate results, quality selection, aspect ratio matching, and step testing.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated inference.sh CLI before workflows can run.
Uses placeholders that users must replace with real prompts, text, URLs, and media assets.
Does not verify output quality, copyright status, or platform policy compliance.
Does not provide a full scheduler, retry system, or asset database.

use_cases.title: Create Short Social Videos
use_cases.description: Turn a topic into a short video plan with script, voiceover, visuals, animation, captions, and final media assembly.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Demos
use_cases.description: Plan a product showcase with generated product imagery, reveal animation, optional upscaling, background music, and final merge steps.

use_cases.title: Convert Blogs To Video
use_cases.description: Standardize a repeatable flow for summarizing articles, creating visuals, animating clips, adding narration, and preserving intermediate assets.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Simple Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a beginner image-to-video pipeline for a 30-second social post about [topic]. Include each stage, expected output, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Short Video Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a YouTube Short workflow for [topic]. Include script generation, voiceover, background visual, animation, captions, and final merge steps.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt A Product Demo
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the product demo workflow for [product]. Include visual prompt direction, voice style, music needs, upscaling, and final review checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Production Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reusable content production pipeline for [team]. Include model choices, naming conventions, review gates, privacy checks, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for a 30-second video pipeline about a new productivity habit.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a staged plan covering script, voiceover, background image, image animation, captions, media merge, and review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A marketer needs a product showcase for wireless earbuds.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines product image generation, reveal animation, optional upscaling, music selection, audio volume, and final assembly checks.

output_examples.input: A team wants to turn a blog post into a video series.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes summarization, point-by-point visuals, clip animation, narration, transitions, and storage of intermediate outputs.

best_practices: Plan each stage before running commands and name expected inputs and outputs.
Save intermediate media and metadata so every step can be reviewed or repeated.
Test one pipeline step at a time before merging final media.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private source material into hosted models without approval.
Do not run installer commands from remote URLs without verification.
Do not chain every step before validating quality, timing, and aspect ratios.

faq.question: Does this skill create media by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and command examples for inference.sh apps that perform media generation and processing.

faq.question: Which workflow steps does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers scripts, research, image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, music, foley, upscaling, merging, and captions.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples require the inference.sh CLI and authentication before app runs can complete.

faq.question: Can I use private content?
faq.answer: Use private material only when your organization allows sending it to hosted model services.

faq.question: Can it automate a full production workflow?
faq.answer: It can outline and sequence steps, but it does not provide a scheduler, retry system, or asset database.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
